primary.title: Gold investment on Dhanteras 2026: Physical gold or gold ETFs? Which offers better tax benefits to investors?
primary.summary: Physical gold and gold ETFs have different capital gains tax rules. While gold ETFs qualify for LTCG taxation after 12 months, physical gold requires a 24-month holding period. Compare tax rates, GST and other costs before investing on Dhanteras 2026.
